title: Which features get used together
description: 8 × 8 co-usage · shade = share of accounts using both · dashed square = strongest pair

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered square co-usage matrix in percent, indexed by features. Diagonal cells are inapplicable; zero is a measured absence. Missing, negative, over-100 and nonfinite values are unavailable.

props.name: features
props.description: Ordered labels shared by rows and columns; repeated names remain separate indexed categories.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
